meal.title: Class attributes shared by all instances
meal.objective: Define a variable on a class that is shared by every instance

voice.script: What if every car you built automatically came out blue? How can we give all objects the same value without setting it each time? A class attribute lives on the class itself, so every instance shares it. Here’s a simple class with a shared counter. Running the program shows both students see the same total count. Class attributes let you store data common to all objects. Add a class attribute to track how many accounts have been created.

visual.code:
class Student:
    total = 0
    def __init__(self, name):
        self.name = name
        Student.total += 1

s1 = Student('Alice')
s2 = Student('Bob')
print('Students created:', Student.total)
